text:
You need a responsive sports betting tips website for NFL/NBA that clearly presents free daily tips, VIP membership, results, FAQ, and contact features with secure payments and smooth performance.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I have 7 years of web development experience building full-stack React/TypeScript applications. For a healthcare staffing client, I built a Staff onboarding portal where nurses uploaded credentials and managers approved them, reducing onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day for 2,400 staff. For a B2B SaaS client, I built Embedded customer analytics so each account saw its own metrics, and it rolled out to 140 customer accounts 3 weeks early.

I can help you create a fast, user-friendly site with React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Stripe, and Tailwind CSS.

Would you like the VIP area to include recurring subscriptions, one-time payments, or both?
